_comment: Authoritative per-match kickoff overrides (UTC), keyed by canonical match id. GENERATED by scripts/build_wc2026_schedule.py from Football-Data.org (/competitions/WC/matches), verified against the official FIFA schedule. The website mirror is website/src/lib/data/wc2026-kickoffs.ts; the two must agree (tests/test_build_wc2026_schedule.py asserts it). Consumed by the snapshot regen to heal the carried-forward matches/*.json kickoffs. A match id absent from `kickoffs` keeps its anchor-derived time, so a partial map is strictly an improvement. Do not edit by hand: hand edits drift back on the next FD refresh.
